name: 3D Convolutional Autoencoder for PVH Refinement
definition: A symmetric autoencoder with 3D convolutional stages and skip connections that learns a mapping F from a low-fidelity PVH (VL) to a high-fidelity PVH (VH) of identical dimensions, effectively hallucinating detail from additional viewpoints.
summary: This symmetric 3D convolutional autoencoder refines low-fidelity Probabilistic Visual Hulls into high-fidelity versions by learning volumetric detail from sparse views, bypassing the need for wide-baseline correspondence.
